current_state.zh: A pre-market digest highlights September US CPI accelerating to 3.7% — sending bitcoin below $83,000 and October Fed hike odds to 43.7% — alongside Anthropic's Pre-IPO investor day, Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering model, ASML's 2030 order inquiries, federal review of SpaceX's Starship expansion, and SK Hynix's AI memory roadmap.
